title: Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Serving closed-circuit and supersport riders, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3 is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1269g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~93 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Track-focused carbon with aerodynamic spoiler and emergency release system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track fit; extended rear coverage for aerodynamic tuck; adjustable retention system optimized for high-G environments.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Track / Race lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3 brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3 represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Track Tech TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
